newsitem.title: USA: VGO tanker refloated off the coast of Texas.
newsitem.headline: VGO tanker refloated off the coast of Texas.

text.p: The tanker Overseas Valdez was refloated Friday and began steaming for Boston after spending the past day grounded in shallow water off the coast of Texas, the U.S. Coast Guard said.

The tanker, loaded with 274,000 barrels of vacuum gasoil (VGO), grounded off Galveston Island at the mouth of the Houston ship channel after snaring a bouy line while passing an inbound ship on Thursday, Coast Guard officials said.
Barges lightered the vessel overnight and an early afternoon high tide lifted the vessel, Petty Officer Travis Inmon said.
There was no leakage from the ship, which is owned by Maritime Overseas Corp of New York and sailed from a Texas City refinery, the Coast Guard said.
Deep draft traffic in the ship channel, a waterway connecting Houston's port and refinery row to the Gulf of Mexico, was unaffected, the Coast Guard said.
